book.name: Wahyu
book.title: WAHYU Men ia Piile' I Yohanes

content: Wiwine tia naga

Mbaka' nokampiile'anmo na langit a sa'angu' oosan kosamba' tuu'. Isian sa'angu' wiwine nolintuum matana ilio ka' na intuna saratna isian wulan. Na takala'na isian songko' men isian bitu'on sompulo' rua'.
Wiwine iya'a mampaiwawa, ka' gause takamo tempona mindompu', mbaka' i ia mangkakaro' kapolosan.
Kasi nokampiile'an soosoodo na langit a oosan kosamba'. Isian sa'angu' naga memea' balaki' tuu', takala'an pipitu' ka' tandukan sompulo'. Na sanda' takala'na isian songko'na tomundo'.

Wolo'na naga iya'a nandaat sangobosan na lalomna tolu' obosan bitu'on men isian na langit ka' ia tuong na tano' balaki'. Naga iya'a nokumekerer na aropna wiwine men boomo mindompu' mempeperai anak men pindompu'kononna bo pulononna.

Mbaka' wiwine iya'a nimindompu'konmo sa'angu' anak moro'one men bo mamarenta giigii' lipu' tia noa mapanas. Kasee ola-olan anak iya'a nirampasi na sinana ka' nitetende'kon waara'a na Alaata'ala na oruangan kobalaki'an-Na.
Wiwine iya'a namareremo na tano' maleas, na dodongoan men ia poko toropotikonmo Tumpu bo ko'ona. Na dodongoan iya'a ia nitotobo' koi sololoon rua' atu nomompulo' ilio a nau'na.
Naga nirungku'i
Mbaka' nosidamo a poopapatean na surugaa. Mikhael tulungionna malaa'ikatna poopapate pootimbangi tia naga, ka' naga' uga' tulungionna malaa'ikatna.
Kasee naga tia malaa'ikatna iya'a norungku', pataka i raaya'a sianmo nipatalai dumodongo na surugaa.

Naga balaki' iya'a nibalo'konmo na tano' balaki' singka-singkat tia giigii' malaa'ikatna. Iamo a ule men mbaripianpo, men ngaanon Ibiliis kabai se' i Satan, men nansala'kon salanna giigii' mian na dunia.
Nanian puntunde'
Kasi yaku' nongorongor wurung boolak na surugaa nangaan taena,

content.text: “Koini'i takamo a tempona Alaata'ala mansalamatkon mian-Na. Koini'i takamo a tempona Alaata'ala mamarenta tia kuasa-Na. Koini'i takamo a tempona Tomundo' Pansalamatkon men nitoonkon mimpipiile'kon kuasa-Na,
gause i ia men mangarait utusta sa'angu' kaparasaya'an na aropna Alaata'ala ilio malom, daa ni'uarkonmo na surugaa.
Utu-utusta men parasaya iya'a nungurungku'imo i ia tia rara'na Anak Domba iya'a, ka' tia lele kana' men ringkat na Alaata'ala men ia lelekon i raaya'a.
Raaya'a maloos a noana mongorookon wakana pataka lapus.
Mbali' iya'a, bi kambelesan a surugaa tia giigii' men dumodongo na lalomna!
Kasee silaka' a tano' balaki' tia tobui, gause Ibiliis nalaumo na ko'omuu tia maso'na men dodoa tuu', gause ia inti'i sianmo manau' a pungkuasaianna mian.”

content: Naga nontorap wiwine men nondodongokon anak moro'one
Sarataa naga iya'a ninginti'i se' i ia nibalo'konmo na tano' balaki', ia nontorapmo wiwine men nondodongokon anak moro'one iya'a.

Kasee wiwine iya'a nitaraimo rurua' lai koi laina sapu' tumpuna men moola', kada' i ia sida lumayang na dodongoanna men nitoropoti na tano' maleas men bo pontotobo'an i ia koi tolu' taun sambande' kada' oloa na dodongoanna naga iya'a.
Kasi naga iya'a nunsupa'kon weer biai' na nganga'na patuk wiwine iya'a kada' bi pa'anus.
Kasee tano' balaki' nuntulungmo wiwine iya'a. Ia nombongkati nganga'na ka' numulon weer men ia supa'kon naga iya'a.
Mbaka' naga iya'a nomaso'konmo tuu' wiwine iya'a, pataka ia nomae'mo mansarak montorap lee'na wiwine iya'a men sambana men malolo' na posuu'na Alaata'ala, ka' men mompotuutuu' i Yesus.
Kasi naga iya'a nokumekerer na soripi'na tobui.
